summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.87. Multiple successful authentications for s.demir@aegean.edu (lab-admin) from a foreign Cloudvault VPS IP (45.142.10.9, Frankfurt, DE) via the explicitly vulnerable vpn-edge-01 appliance, with no device_id recorded. MFA was approved only once (21:31) and then seven subsequent portal/LMS successes occurred with zero MFA prompts over ~30 minutes, indicating session/MFA bypass after initial compromise. The rapid alternating portal/lms access pattern is consistent with automated attacker activity rather than normal admin use. This meets the threshold for confirmed account takeover: disable the account, reset credentials, re-enroll MFA, revoke all sessions, and investigate the vulnerable VPN appliance.
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
